ops.title: Installing a newer cci anywhere activates it: the daemon hands off to it
ops.body: A running cci daemon watches for a newer install (cask Caskroom or plugin cache) and runs `<newest> serve` itself (internal/daemon/upgrade.go:46, logged "cci daemon handing off to a newer install"). So `brew upgrade --cask yasyf/tap/cci` or a plugin update IS daemon activation, not a passive install. Ensure (daemonkit) restarts on any build mismatch in either direction, and the plugin SessionStart hook (matcher unset: startup/resume/clear/compact) runs ensureDaemon with the newest unorphaned plugin version. Upgrading one channel while another stays older makes the daemon flap: on 2026-10-16 a lone cask upgrade to 0.20.5 with the plugin at 0.20.4 produced 26 handoffs and ~50 restarts in 2h12m. Move plugin, cask and standalone (~/.local/bin/cci) together; `cci upgrade` does all three and then serves the newest.
